# Exported names of the packages under internal that stay exported though
# no non-test file of cmd or of another package that is not a test helper
# (a package whose name ends in "test") names them as <package>.<Name>; a
# test helper's name passes on a use in any file of another package, and a
# type passes when a passing name of its package reaches it.
# exports_test.go fails on such a name missing here and on a line here that
# no longer applies. The names under "# not yet examined" are a baseline. One
# name per line, "<directory under internal>.<Name> <reason>". Only top-level
# functions, types, variables and constants are checked.

jsonvalue.Decode tests of other packages build their JSON input with it
parserkit.CarriedProblem the parsers' carried-value tests build the expected problem text with it
parserkit.CountingWork the parsers' cost tests count each read with it
parserkit.Within parsertest runs each parser test's parse through it
sqlitefile.BlobAffinity one of SQLite's five affinities, which Column.Affinity can hold
sqlitefile.BlobValue tests of other packages build expected values with it
sqlitefile.FloatValue tests of other packages build expected values with it
sqlitefile.IntegerAffinity one of SQLite's five affinities, which Column.Affinity can hold
sqlitefile.NumericAffinity one of SQLite's five affinities, which Column.Affinity can hold
sqlitefile.OpenBytes sqlitetest's tests open the databases it builds with it
sqlitefile.RealAffinity one of SQLite's five affinities, which Column.Affinity can hold
tomldoc.KindDatetime one of TOML's value kinds, which Value.Kind can return
tomldoc.KindLocalDate one of TOML's value kinds, which Value.Kind can return
tomldoc.KindLocalDatetime one of TOML's value kinds, which Value.Kind can return
tomldoc.KindLocalTime one of TOML's value kinds, which Value.Kind can return
tomldoc.KindString one of TOML's value kinds, which Value.Kind can return
version.Version set at build time by -ldflags -X in .github/go-build.sh
